class.name: IfcStructuralLoadSingleForce
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralLoadSingleForce shall be used to define the forces and moments of an action operating on a single point. HISTORY: New entity in Release IFC2x edition 2.

members.member: Force value in x-direction. A float, or null when unset.
Force value in y-direction. A float, or null when unset.
Force value in z-direction. A float, or null when unset.
Moment about the x-axis. A float, or null when unset.
Moment about the y-axis. A float, or null when unset.
Moment about the z-axis. A float, or null when unset.
